name: Motion-adaptive latent sharpen and retime
plain: Sharpens video latent frames in proportion to frame-to-frame change, with a fixed binomial blur high pass. The sibling retime node adjusts apparent speed by subtracting velocity from frames. Works on raw latent differences, not optical flow.
math:
mmap=mean|f[t]−f[t−1]| / max, optional temporal [.25,.5,.25]
astr=base+clamp(mmap−θ,0)/(1−θ+1e−6)·k; hf=x−B∗x; out=x+astr·hf
retime (docstring): f′[t]=f[t]−v[t](1−scale)·strength
